source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: During your own [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) the bearer’s unit can recover lost models. Roll D3 for the maximum you can recover, or use a cap of 3 if you control an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) in the unit’s range. An Attached unit cannot recover **CHARACTER** models this way. Any **[[ONE SHOT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/one-shot)** weapon fired before the model was destroyed remains spent when it returns.

detail.oneShotState: retains prior firing state of each returned model
